item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
Leela packs lunch.

Which choice supports healthy eating: wholesome food, a sensible amount, and a suitable time?

options.A: The smallest nibble of dal, treating the smallest portion as always healthiest.
options.B: Dal and rice at midday, in an amount she can finish.
options.C: Only a sweet chosen for bright colour, with no care for amount or time.
options.D: Skipping food until late night, then eating a very large amount at once.

learn_by_solve.solve: Decide whether a mixture is homogeneous or heterogeneous from uniformity, visible particles, and settling.

followup.stem: Assign oxidation numbers first. The species is [[1]] if OS increases, [[2]] if OS decreases, or [[3]] if OS stays the same.
followup.why: A mixture with uniform composition throughout is homogeneous; a mixture that is not uniform, has visible particles, or settles with time is heterogeneous. This is the hinge move, not a reprint of the clicked option.
